intent: Integrate independently reviewed modules without concurrent CI edits
expected_result: Source-bound combined checks and durable branch/publication receipts

outputs.contract: Source-bound combined checks and durable branch/publication receipts

acceptance.check: Focused module receipts, combined fast check, real accounting SQL, exact remote branch and workspace source readback
No skipped transport check, unavailable board or publication mismatch is reported as passing

guards: Own only listed paths; no foreign registry, process, credential or installation changes
No native PASS from compiler/fake acceptance; bind reports to candidate SHA
One heavy check slot; do not duplicate installs

resume.next: Read producer receipts and current plan; implement only owned module
resume.after_change: Independent review, fix findings, bind exact source hashes
